name: Attention ROI warp
summary: Registers a T1-weighted brain image to MNI152 with ANTs (rigid, affine and SyN) and warps a bundled set of attention-network ROIs from Sani et al. into the subject's T1 space.
description: This service aligns two sets of Regions of Interest (ROIs) from Sani et al., in preparation to the individual subject space. A first set of ROIs has been obtained by thresholding functional MRI data. A second set of ROIs has been obtained by creating sphere ROIs around the peak of functional MRI activation. The ROIs are stored here: https://github.com/brainlife/VisWMROIWarp/tree/master/rois

inputs.description: Skull-stripped T1-weighted image of the subject.
inputs.requirements: Registered to the MNI152 1 mm brain template, so it should be brain-extracted.

inputs.description: Brain mask of the T1w image, used as the moving mask during registration.

outputs.description: The attention ROIs (fMRI-thresholded and 10 mm sphere ROIs shipped with the App) resampled into the subject's T1 space with the inverse ANTs transform.

citations.text: Avesani P, McPherson B, Hayashi S, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).
